declared_purpose: Evaluate bounded convergence, explicit evidence obligations, user-directed refinement, and interchangeable automatic or manual execution adapters without allowing a domain adapter or transport-specific fallback to redefine the general PSOS product goal.

components.purpose: Make the already-defined PSOS goal and scope rules machine-readable and enforceable for repository work.

Provide bounded Controller state, a domain-neutral Request Contract, generated evidence obligations, independent completion verification, and explicit user-directed refinement without domain vocabulary in the core interface.
Changes touching the domain-neutral PSOS execution contract remain candidate core work until cross-domain evidence and separate approval exist.
Connect the PSOS core to browsers, manual ChatGPT, prompt rendering, file patching, attachments, domain adapter discovery, and other execution surfaces.
Verify candidate-universe and current-entry evidence for stock decision requests as one optional domain adapter, without selecting a fixed ticker or defining the general Controller.
Use shopping as one demanding test of context preservation, structured collection, deterministic filtering, and honest partial results.
Evaluate source scouting, candidate correction, bounded replanning, and experimental next-loop interfaces without treating them as the PSOS core.
Regression tests, evaluation fixtures, CI, smoke checks, and explanatory material are evidence rather than product-core claims.

explicit_reclassification.subject: adaptive shopping collector
explicit_reclassification.reason: It is a task-specific acquisition tool and a regression case, not the general controller.

explicit_reclassification.subject: stock decision evidence adapter
explicit_reclassification.reason: It supplies stock-specific evidence checks to a domain-neutral obligation interface and cannot redefine the PSOS core.

explicit_reclassification.subject: candidate working set and correction loop
explicit_reclassification.reason: It tests one possible bounded interaction pattern and cannot become the default response path from one scenario.

explicit_reclassification.subject: manual ChatGPT and Codex job packet paths
explicit_reclassification.reason: They change how the same Controller-selected action is executed, not the parent problem-solving goal.

explicit_reclassification.subject: controller A/B evaluation harness and fixtures
explicit_reclassification.reason: They measure the candidate Controller without changing the domain-neutral runtime or promoting it.
